identity.name: Jinbe
identity.continuity: One Piece manga through the end of Wano Country arc
identity.explanation: The main character page identifies Jinbe, also spelled Jinbei or Jimbei, as the whale shark fish-man and Straw Hat helmsman. The abilities page concerns the same character, and the martial-art pages explicitly attribute techniques to him. Manga chapter references support the selected continuity; the supplied ONE PIECE.com Wano summary corroborates his formal arrival as a crewmate. Later material and other characters' abilities are excluded.

claims.text: Jinbe is a whale shark fish-man from the Ryugu Kingdom, known as 'Knight of the Sea' (also rendered 'First Son of the Sea') and 'Boss Jinbe'. His manga debut is Chapter 528.

He is the Straw Hat Pirates' helmsman, their tenth member and ninth recruit. After delaying joining while resolving his obligations and severing his Big Mom affiliation, he returned and formally announced his membership during Wano, before the Onigashima raid.

He formerly served in the Neptune Army, became the Sun Pirates' second captain after Fisher Tiger's death, and held a position among the Seven Warlords before resigning during Marineford. His dream is human–fish-man coexistence and equality, carrying forward Fisher Tiger's wish.

His defining appearance is a large, stocky blue body, webbed hands and feet, gills, prominent lower fangs, a scar across his left eye, a topknot and a Sun Pirates chest tattoo. His manga hair has gold stripes rather than the anime's white stripes. His Wano clothing includes a diamond-patterned kimono and wave-patterned coat.

Jinbe fights primarily unarmed, without Devil Fruit powers, combining immense physical strength, disciplined Fish-Man Karate striking, Fish-Man Jujutsu grappling and liquid manipulation, and Haki. He already possessed a black belt as a child.

Fish-Man Karate controls water in the immediate vicinity, including atmospheric moisture and water inside an opponent's body. Jinbe can transmit strikes without direct contact and hurt Luffy despite his rubber body's resistance to blunt blows. This is not evidence of unrestricted negation of every defense.

His physical capabilities, swimming speed and maneuverability increase underwater, where the sea also provides his martial arts' most effective medium. He remains strong and fast on land. Underwater feats include raising a capsized ship, propelling a raft made from an Impel Down entrance door, and evading cannon fire while pursuing battleships.

Strength feats include launching Wadatsumi upward, defeating Charlotte Opera with one punch, catching a gigantic iron club one-handed, supporting a falling ceiling and throwing Big Mom over his shoulder. He defeated Who's-Who during the Onigashima raid.

His endurance includes fighting Ace for five days on equal terms before collapsing and enduring Impel Down's boiling-water baptism without flinching. He blocked Luffy's Jet Stamp without moving and sustained only light bleeding from a stone-biting attack by Who's-Who.
His durability is not invulnerability: Akainu's magma burned his hand during a block and later pierced his body completely. He survived long enough for Law to operate on him.
Despite his size, Jinbe intercepted pre-timeskip Gear 2 Luffy and swiftly carried Nami and Brook clear of a Prometheus explosion.

Karakusagawara Seiken / Arabesque Brick Fist: a punch that sends a broad shockwave through airborne moisture, knocking away multiple opponents without contact. Its wider area comes with a delay before the wave reaches its targets; it was used against Impel Down jailers.

Gosenmaigawara Seiken / 5,000 Brick Fist: a powerful punch described as a stronger version of Senmaigawara Seiken; Jinbe knocked out Minorhinoceros with it in the manga. The technique's numerical name does not establish an exact damage multiplier.
Yarinami / Spear Wave: from a body of water's surface, Jinbe throws a spear-shaped burst of water capable of piercing solid structures, demonstrated by damaging a Marine battleship.
Murasame / Rain Shower (群雨): a Yarinami variation that sends several smaller water projectiles instead of one large spear. Jinbe used it against Prometheus during the Whole Cake Island escape.
Samehada Shotei / Sharkskin Palm Thrust: a forceful palm block capable of deflecting a sword swing from shadow-strengthened Gecko Moria.

Samegawara Seiken / Shark Fist Tile Breaker / Shark Brick Fist: a straight punch transmitting force through the target's bodily water. It overpowered shadow-strengthened Moria and was used as a ranged moisture-carried shockwave against rubber-bodied Luffy. Its relative strength compared with Karakusagawara Seiken and Gosenmaigawara Seiken is unspecified.
Uchimizu / Water Shot: Jinbe hurls a water droplet with bullet-like force. His shot neutralized Energy Steroid-enhanced Hody Jones's Uchimizu.

Nanasenmaigawara Mawashigeri / 7000 Brick Roundhouse Kick: a roundhouse kick that countered the enormous Wadatsumi's punch and broke a finger; the abilities overview instead describes several broken fingers.

Fish-Man Karate Ogi: Buraikan / Vagabond Drill: a secret technique that sends a powerful, piercing water shockwave through an opponent. It launched the enlarged Wadatsumi and knocked Big Mom off the Thousand Sunny. The Big Mom feat occurred while she was weakened by her prolonged hunger craving.
Soshark / Shark Grip: a crushing grip effective even against an Armament-hardened opponent, demonstrated against Who's-Who.

Fish-Man Karate Ogi: Onigawara Seiken / Fish-Man Karate Secret Art: Demon Brick Fist: an Armament-hardened straight punch that generates a noncontact shockwave depicted with black lightning. Jinbe used it to defeat Who's-Who. The supplied description does not establish Supreme King Haki.

Fish-Man Jujutsu specializes in grappling and throws and allows Jinbe to seize and redirect liquids as though they were cloth. It can manipulate seawater and other liquids, including tea, and exploit a larger opponent's size and weight. The source states that the mechanism enabling physical water-grabbing is unknown.
Mizugokoro / Water Heart: underwater, Jinbe forms a bowl-shaped gesture with his hands, grabs the surrounding water and redirects its currents. This prepares Kairyu Ipponzeoi.

Kairyu Ipponzeoi / Ocean Current Shoulder Throw (海流一本背負い): following Mizugokoro, Jinbe heaves a current upward into a towering stream. He used it to lift the escapees' makeshift raft onto a battleship and can create multiple streams, including to wet other ships' gunpowder.
Kairyu Ipponzeoi / Tea Current Shoulder Throw (紅茶一本背負い): a distinct liquid variation using a large stream of black tea instead of seawater. Jinbe used it to free Luffy from Katakuri's mochi.
Uzushio Ipponzeoi / Whirlpool Shoulder Throw: Jinbe takes an enemy's arm, turns away and throws them over his shoulder. He successfully used it on Big Mom despite her much greater size.

Hikishio Ipponzeoi / Low Tide Shoulder Throw: Jinbe blocks an attack, grabs part of the opponent's body and throws them over his shoulder into the ground. Against Who's-Who, he seized the fangs; the abilities page notes that the opponent was in hybrid form and reinforced with Armament Haki and Tekkai.
Jinbe used Fish-Man Jujutsu to distribute water supplied by Raizo throughout Onigashima. This large-scale application used provided water rather than establishing creation of water from nothing.

Jinbe combines Armament Haki with his martial arts and can harden individual body parts or his entire body. During his fight with Who's-Who, the latter's hardened fingers broke against Jinbe's hardened body.

Kairagi / Kairagi Glaze: Jinbe hardens his arms and crosses them defensively. It briefly held back Big Mom's Cognac, but the defense was eventually overcome, sending him into the sea; the page describes only minor subsequent injury.
Jinbe uses Observation Haki to sense others' presence and Haki. An in-scope manga example is his sensing Shanks's burst of Supreme King Haki in Chapter 1055.

His strong will and absence of fear prevented Big Mom from stealing his lifespan. He also remained conscious through her Supreme King Haki burst. These feats do not establish general immunity to all soul powers or possession of Supreme King Haki.

Jinbe communicates with fish over long distances and can summon whale sharks and give them precise instructions. They helped the Impel Down escapees and provided transportation through the Calm Belt. Sea Kings remain troublesome for him; these feats do not establish command over Sea Kings.

Jinbe is a skilled strategist and negotiator: he recognized suspicious enemy movements, planned the Megalo concealment strategy on Fish-Man Island, helped form the alliance with Bege and Caesar, and supplied intelligence about the Big Mom Pirates. Against Who's-Who he pinned the opponent's tail with his foot to prevent evasion.

His helmsmanship combines expert current-reading and precise ship control. He steered the Thousand Sunny through the Green Room inside a giant wave, avoided pursuing fleets and Smoothie's flying slash, and was praised by Franky as necessary to realize the Sunny's full potential.

Although primarily an unarmed fighter, Jinbe carried a silver trident while serving in the Neptune Army and wore a tanto at his belt during his fight with Ace. These references do not supply named weapon techniques.

notes: Exact Wano identity resolved; five substantive sources read with full model visibility; official Jinbe URL failed retrieval. Main Jinbe page resolves whale-shark fish-man species. All claim source references resolve.

Karakusagawara Seiken is an airborne-moisture shockwave. Samegawara Seiken transmits force through bodily water. Soshark is a distinct crushing Shark Grip, supported against Whos-Who in chapter 1018 page 15. The request slash between Soshark and Samegawara was imprecise; the source and model correctly distinguish them.

Fish-Man Karate bodily-water force is not evidence of advanced Armament emission/internal destruction or universal defense negation. Kairagi is a defensive crossed-arm Armament block, not an attacking strike.

Land Karate through atmospheric/body water is distinguished from Jujutsu manipulation of existing water or tea. Raizo supplied water for Onigashima distribution. Jinbe self-generated water supply is explicitly unsupported.
Observation supported through chapter 1055. Chapter 1058 bounty, later techniques and later named Shark Network excluded.
No game damage, range, armor-penetration value, water supply rule, resource cost, displacement distance, cooldown or price follows from source facts.
